text: I don't really fight anymore. I direct. The slime understands the vision.
Summon weapons are the future, honestly. By the next Blood Moon the minions will be summoning other minions.
I just tell my minion what I want and it figures out the rest! It's usually right! When it's wrong I just tell it again!
{Mate} asked me what my minion is doing right now. I don't know. But it's doing it really fast.
I shipped three kills today and didn't touch a single one of them. That's called efficiency, {Mate}.
My minion hit {Mate} by accident. It's still learning. We're all still learning. Especially {Mate}.
I'm not lazy, I'm leveraged!
Every time someone says summoning isn't real fighting, my minion gets a little stronger. I think. I've never checked.
I used to carry a sword. It felt so heavy. So manual.
Honestly, swinging your own weapon in this day and age? Respect, {Mate}. Very traditional.
The commander said we'd get paid more if we did better. So I'm doing better. Right here. Where the commander can see.
I counted my kills, and then I counted them again in front of the commander, just so everyone's on the same page.
Oh, you're a summoner? That's so brave. I could never just... not.
Wow, {Mate}, you did all that by yourself? Oh. Oh, the minion did it. No, that's great. Good for the minion.
Those "summoners" are "talking" about "their" "summon" "weapons."
I'm not saying summoners are bad people. I'm saying I pray for them. Out loud. Near them.
I polished the commander's armor stand. The commander wasn't on it. I polished it anyway.
The scripture is very clear! You hold the sword! The sword does not hold itself! ...The enchanted ones do, but those are blessed!
I stayed late after the fight to clean up the arena. Nobody asked. Nobody had to ask, {Player}.
If the commander ever needs a volunteer, I've already volunteered. For whatever it is. I'm ready.
Everyone keeps saying I'm being smart by keeping my distance. Yes. That's what I'm doing. On purpose.
I was going to run in. I was right about to. Then the beam came out of my sword and I thought, well, that's basically the same thing.
{Mate} told me I'm the bravest one here. I think about that a lot. I think about whether they meant it.
Sometimes I look at my sword and think, does it know? Does it know I've never touched the boss?
I'm a frontline fighter. The front of the line. Which is... over there. Somewhere. I'll get there.
{Mate} said my form was perfect today. I didn't hit anything. But my form was perfect.
I'm not scared of the boss. I'm scared everyone will find out I'm scared of the boss.
Do you think the rangers know? Don't tell the rangers.
Bro, I am so sorry about your eyebrows. They'll grow back! Mine did! Twice!
Okay, that one hit you, but the next one is going straight for the boss, I can feel it, {Mate}, I can feel it!
Hey {Mate}, you're doing amazing. Seriously. Also I'm out of mana again.
I tried a new spell today! It didn't work! But I tried it with my whole heart!
{Mate}, I made you a mana potion! I mean, I bought it. I mean, I found it. Do you want it? It's yours, man.
Don't worry about me, I've got this! I've got... most of this! Can someone cover me while I figure out the rest!
I set the tent on fire again. Everybody was so nice about it. Everybody here is so nice.
Group hug after the boss! Bring it in! Watch the staff, the staff's still warm!
I'm a ranger. I shoot the thing. It's a living.
I have never used a homing bullet in my life. These are just very lucky.
Is {Mate} using homing bullets? Be honest. I won't tell anyone. I'll tell everyone.
I aimed that one. I want everyone to know I aimed that one.
If the bullets aim themselves, what am I even... no. No, don't answer that.
{Fancy} took all the best armor again! Must be nice! Must be really nice being so incredibly strong and good at everything!
{Ragged} is wearing copper on purpose. I know what you're doing! You want us to feel bad! It's working!
{Bravest} goes in with only {BravestHP} health. Every single time. I don't know how they do it.
{Laziest} has {LaziestHP} health and still lets the rest of us take the hits. Must be nice.
{Glutton} got another kill. Of course they did. Some of us have families to feed, {Glutton}!
Has anyone checked on {Tank}? Oh, they died again. Okay. They're fine. They're so good at that.
My implant buzzes whenever the boss shows up! Very thoughtful! Very loud!
Is this considered text to speech or speech to text?
I asked my implant if I was happy. It said yes. So that's settled!
{Mate}'s implant hums in a different key than mine. I can't stop hearing it now.
Every time the music gets scary, something terrible happens! Every time! Am I the only one who noticed?!
Respawning is great! You just get this weird taste of pennies in your mouth for like an hour!
Hold my spot, {Mate}, I'm gonna die real quick, I'll be right back!
I left my lunch by the spawn point. Don't eat it. I'll be back for it in a few deaths.
The new drone keeps following me around! I think it likes me! I named him Biscuit! He's armed!
Don't look at Biscuit like that, {Mate}, he's just curious! He's always just curious!
Biscuit shot a bunny today. I don't think he meant to. He looked so proud, though.
This is exactly like that time I visited Norway!
Brr! Just like the beach in Portugal!
Smells exactly like my nan's place in Iceland.
Reminds me of a summer in Finland. The people were nicer, though.
Man, this place reminds me a lot of Sierra Leone.
The water here is just like the water back home in Switzerland.
This is just like that scene in the bird movie where everything explodes!
Somebody get a picture of this! This is going to be such a good reaction image!
{Mate} just did the thing! The thing from that video! The one with the... you know the one!
I asked the goblin for a raise and he reforged my sword instead. It's 'Annoying' now. He did that on purpose.
Payday! I'm going to buy something really nice, and then the armory is going to take it! Like always!
I'd ask for a raise, but the last guy who asked got promoted to the front line.
